summary: Published Polish supplier prices checked on 11 November 2026. Plant prices are for supply only unless stated. Prices vary with cultivar, root ball, density, quantity, access and transport. Automatic Smaragd estimates stop at 4 m; taller specimen references are not a uniform hedge quote.
taxNote: Retail prices are recorded as displayed. Explicit net prices remain labelled net. Editable model rates are consumer planning budgets; supplier VAT and final quotes must be confirmed. No blanket VAT rate is asserted for the entire project.

sources.title: H.M. Serdyńscy — Smaragd retail stock
sources.priceBasis: Displayed retail PLN per plant; VAT not separately stated on the price table
sources.note: Current public stock list. Root-ball size and transport need supplier confirmation.

sources.title: Tuje24 — premium Smaragd and planting
sources.note: Planting surcharge 39–99 PLN/plant, minimum 50 plants. Seller suggests 0.5 m spacing for small pots, 0.6 m up to 2 m, 0.8 m for 2–2.6 m. These spacings do not guarantee instant opaque screening. Stock 1.4–1.8 m marked sold out.

sources.title: Szkółka Jaśmin — small Smaragd
sources.note: Product page height 40–60 cm; delivery extra.

sources.title: PLANT.PL — autumn 2026 wholesale
sources.priceBasis: Explicit net PLN; supplier states add 8% VAT
sources.note: Root-ball height excluded. Free delivery applies only to 50+ plants within 50 km of the nursery in Małopolska, not automatically to Gdańsk.

sources.title: Szkółka Czaple — local price check
sources.note: Czaple near Gdańsk. Listed prices are not a delivered and planted quote.

sources.title: PoKrusz — bulk fill and topsoil
sources.priceBasis: Material prices explicitly net; transport separate
sources.note: National price reference, not a Gdańsk delivery quote. Conversion between tonnes and cubic metres depends on actual loose bulk density.

sources.title: Koparka Gdańsk — local earthworks rates
sources.note: Published starting rates; do not include every soil material, haulage, access, retaining or drainage requirement.

sources.title: TujaSzmaragd.com — delivery reference
sources.note: Mixed sizes are quoted individually. This table does not price heavy 3–6 m trees; packages may include delivery under separate conditions.

tallStockReferences.taxBasis: NET; VAT not specified in this price table
tallStockReferences.note: 2026/27 list, regular offer through March 2027. Species suitable for hedging, but width, number of matching plants, transport and machinery are unquoted.

tallStockReferences.title: Galeria Ogrodowa — Brabant specimen, 5–6 m
tallStockReferences.taxBasis: Displayed retail price; VAT not separately stated
tallStockReferences.stockType: German solitary specimen, transplanted six times
tallStockReferences.note: Transport calculated separately. Unloading generally arranged by the customer. This is not ordinary bulk Smaragd hedge stock.

spacingM.basis: Editable quantity assumption; seller guidance exists for 2–2.6 m Smaragd. Taller or smaller stock needs spacing chosen for actual crown and root-ball widths.

fillMaterialPLNPerM3.basis: Editable planning amount. Order-of-magnitude derived from 40 PLN/net tonne at an assumed 1.5 t/m3 and illustrative 23% gross-up; neither density nor tax treatment is a project quote.

topsoilPLNPerM3.basis: Editable planning amount near published 90 PLN/net m3 after an illustrative 23% gross-up.

placementPLNPerM3.basis: Editable planning amount near local embankment starting rate 40 PLN/net m3; actual compaction and access requirements may change it.

planningAssumptions.deliveryAccessRetentionDrainage: Allowances must remain separately editable and labelled provisional; no verified all-in site quote exists.
planningAssumptions.settlement: Any loose-volume uplift is a planning factor, not a geotechnical compaction specification.
planningAssumptions.above4M: Request a supplier quote and enter it per hedge side. Do not interpolate ordinary 4 m stock into specialist 6 m specimens or extrapolate to 15 m.
